expires_today.title: Make Your Own Games In Unreal
expires_today.long_description:
Learn how to create your own video games in Unreal Engine with the power of C++ from the pros at GameDev.tv! This all-new Humble Video Learning Bundle contains everything you need to learn the fundamentals. Master modern game development with comprehensive courses designed to help you succeed quickly, including Math For Video Games, FPS Music Asset, and Unreal Engine Blueprint Game Developer. Get the expert education you seek from the professionals at GameDev.tv, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 29th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Amazing Creator-Owned Comics by DSTLRY
expires_today.long_description:
Celebrate an all-star lineup of comics creators and the publisher that makes it all happen with this collection of favorites from DSTLRY! Every DSTLRY book is creator-owned, so your support goes directly to the people who make the comics. Embark on a tense time-travel yarn in Time Waits, a sci-fi adventure from Chip Zdarsky, David Brothers, and Marcus To! Uncover the secrets of a fantastical floating city in Simon Spurrier and Matías Bergara's A Mischief of Magpies! Survive the witch hunts and awaken supernatural beings in Becky Cloonan and Tula Lotay's erotic folk-horror Somna! Discover even more incredible stories and journeys into the unknown in this bundle of more than 40 fan-favorite comics! Name your price, and support the Book Industry Charitable Foundation (BINC) with your purchase!

Available on Neon Ichiban, with DRM-free downloads.

expires_today.title: Beyond Reality: Sci-Fi & Survival VR Collection
expires_today.long_description:
Blast off to faraway stars or stay home and hide from monsters in the woods with this bundle of sci-fi and horror (and sci-fi horror) VR games! Explore a derelict spaceship while fighting off an entity determined to mutate your own body in Star Trek: Infection! Command a fleet of ships through evolving stages of space battles in Homeworld: Vast Reaches! Run through the woods finding stick figures and hiding from a creature of terror and darkness in Blair Witch VR! Fully immerse yourself in outer space adventures and Earthbound terror with these VR games! Get them all now at the price of your choice and support HPV Cancers Alliance with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 28th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Indie Fighters
expires_today.long_description:
You’d better brush up on your combat skills if you want to take on these indie fighting games! Harness the power of the four elements to clobber your opponents to dust in Rivals of Aether II! Explore even more fighting game fun in this bundle of brawlers—you choose what you pay, and every purchase supports the rare disease research organization Raiden Science Foundation!

expires_today.title: The Ultimate Gene Wolfe Library by Tor Books
expires_today.description: New suns, ancient lands, and beyond
expires_today.long_description: Sci-fi and fantasy master Gene Wolfe’s novels and long-running series span all facets of genre fiction, each one unlike anything else ever written. For anyone looking to get into one of the greats, we’ve partnered with Tor Books to bring you the best of Gene Wolfe in one massive library! Enter the world of the genre-bending Book of the New Sun series with the Dying Earth fantasy of Shadow and Claw! Travel back to Ancient Greece with an amnesiac mercenary manipulated by the gods in Soldier of the Mist! Meet a young boy destined to become a warrior and more in the mythology remix The Knight! Nearly 40 novels, short story collections, and more are featured in this truly giant bundle, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Alzheimer’s Research UK with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Ultimate SFX for Games
expires_today.long_description: Function Loops has assembled a massive collection that brings together 3 bundles and 44 packs total, including fresh sample packs never released before.
